candidate.name: Microduck
candidate.summary:
指定选题：Hugging Face / Pollen Robotics 的 Microduck 迷你双足机器鸭。优先生成该产品的中文待审核洞察。本轮只有公开资料，没有作者实机或模拟器使用记录，不得虚构实测、购买或训练经历。
研究主线：可爱的机器鸭怎样让用户从看演示走向训练自己的机器人？分析预设动作降低首次体验门槛，以及训练、部署、分享能否支持持续创造。区分普通玩家、教育使用者和开发者，不预设大众化或长期留存已验证。区分手柄控制、预设动作、模拟器体验与自行训练，不把动作演示等同于理解任意自然语言或自主做家务。
公开来源：官网 https://pollen-robotics.com/microduck/ ，发布稿 https://pollen-robotics.com/microduck/blog/introducing-microduck/ ，软件 https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck ，训练 https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl ，模拟器 https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator 。请核对发布日期、预售价格和首批交付计划，明确官方宣称与独立反馈的区别。开源不代表零训练成本，不混淆机身重量和抓取载荷。
同类调研优先 Reachy Mini：https://pollen-robotics.com/reachy-mini/ ，比较互动表达与动作训练的定位，不做笼统能力排名。其他相近产品只在可靠来源支持时纳入，不能编造或把预售讨论当成已收货反馈。
遵循仓库金标准与标题摘要规范：约5分钟中文文章，7板块和产品启示，段落不要太碎，每板块重点加粗1-2处。以产品机制、能力边界和PM判断为主，少堆参数，资料缺口明确保留给人工审核。同步生成X英文短帖（真实换行、完整句子、不超过280字符）、小红书300-500字正文、信息充分的轮播文字和截图清单。所有输出保持draft，创建待审核PR，不自动发布。

score.reason: Manual selection with clear research brief; Microduck offers deep product mechanisms (training, simulation) and strong public evidence from official sources.

verified_facts: Microduck is a tiny biped robot that can be trained with reinforcement learning and is playable out of the box.
Pre-orders for Microduck open on August 27, 2026, at a price of $399 before taxes and shipping.
Microduck is trained in simulation and deployed on the real robot; the simulator is available on Hugging Face.
Every behavior of Microduck is a policy that can be retrained on the user's own machine or on Hugging Face Jobs.
The robot ships with a battery, USB-C cable, and game controller; additional packs include spare parts and accessories.
The software stack, including the SDK, simulation, and RL training stack, is available on GitHub under a permissive license (Apache 2.0).
Microduck comes in four colorways with the same internal hardware.
The community for Microduck lives on Discord.
Pollen Robotics also offers Reachy Mini, a larger robot, and Microduck complements it.
The official blog post about Microduck was published on August 27, 2026.
The simulator is described as the 'simulated twin' on which the ducks were trained.
Microduck can perform behaviors such as velocity-tracking gait, sitting down and standing up, one-shot boot, dipping beak to ground, roller skating with skates, and getting up from flat on its back.
